jobs.description:
Context & Environment: Are you looking to grow your career in the vibrant world of innovation in energy trading? Take your first steps into a fulfilling career and join our team for 6 months as an intern! Do you have a background related to Instructional Design, Education Technology or Digital Media? If yes, we would love to see your profile! Operations Technical Services ( OTS ), part of TotalEnergies Trading & Shipping is looking to hire an intern to support TotalEnergies’ ambitions and growth. By joining the team, the intern will support the NextGen Ops Learning initiative , aimed at transforming traditional operational training (currently in PPT/PDF format) into engaging microlearning video modules . This role is critical to reducing dependency on manual, expert-led training and creating a scalable, digital knowledge library for trading operators worldwide. Activities:
• Content Conversion
• Review existing PowerPoint decks, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and process notes to extract essential content.
• Work hand-by-hand with training owners to define learning objectives and structure modules using microlearning principles.
• Rewrite technical content into clear, operator-friendly language.
• Develop storyboards and outlines for video modules.
• eLearning Build
• Create interactive learning modules using internal tools (e.g., VIBE, Synthesia).
• Incorporate learning interactions such as click-to-reveal steps, scenario questions, and knowledge checks (Multiple-Choice Questions – MCQs, true/false, drag-and-drop).
• Apply consistent templates for layout, navigation, and typography.
• Visual Design & Animation
• Redesign slides for clarity and visual hierarchy.
• Produce simple animations and reusable visual assets (icons, diagrams).
• Maintain a clean, professional design aligned with TOTSA standards.
• Subject Matter Expert (SME) Review & Quality Assurance
• Coordinate review cycles with SMEs.
• Validate technical accuracy and compliance with internal standards. Perform QA checks for navigation, scoring, and accessibility. Objectives
• Convert 80+ critical operational trainings into interactive, digital modules. Deliver high-quality, visually engaging microlearning content that accelerates onboarding and improves knowledge retention . Candidate Profile: Must-Have Skills
• Ability to simplify content and communicate clearly.
• Strong prompting skills.
• Understanding of instructional format principles (objectives, practice, checks).
• Attention to detail and quality mindset.
• Comfortable working with SMEs and managing iterative feedback.
• Basic motion graphics and visual design capability.
• Fluent English Tools
• PowerPoint (advanced level).
• eLearning authoring tools (VIBE, Synthesia or similar).
• Graphic design tools (Canva, Figma, Illustrator or equivalent). Education / Experience
• Last year of Master degree in Instructional Design, Education Technology, Digital Media, UX, or similar.
• Portfolio demonstrating PPT-to-eLearning conversion and visual design skills.
• A tripartite agreement is mandatory Additional Information: TotalEnergies values diversity, promotes individual growth and offers equal opportunity careers.

jobs.title: Asset Dispatch Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
Context & Environment: TotalEnergies has established its European trading hub in Geneva, bringing together large multidisciplinary teams across trading activities, including TotalEnergies Trading & Shipping (T&S) and TotalEnergies Gas & Power (TGP) . TGP is the trading arm of TotalEnergies for low‑carbon energies, focusing primarily on natural gas, LNG and power . The business operates in highly dynamic markets shaped by price volatility, supply–demand imbalances, evolving climate policies, changes in the energy mix and the rapid development of new energy technologies. These trends require continuous adaptation, innovation and operational excellence. Within this environment, TGP plays a critical role in optimizing the Group’s gas and power portfolios across European and global markets, ensuring competitiveness and supporting TotalEnergies in its strategic ambition to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050 . The Asset Dispatch Operations Engineer will operate at the heart of this transformation, contributing to the reliable dispatch and control of a growing portfolio of renewable and flexible assets. The role is central to enabling safe real‑time operations, market compliance and the continued expansion of TotalEnergies’ power activities. Activities: In this role, you will contribute to the development of a profitable model in power, aiming for net power production of over 100 TWh by 2030, thanks to a competitive portfolio of renewable assets (solar and on- and offshore wind) and flexible facilities (CCGTs, energy storage). This position owns the asset dispatch and control layer, as well as the integration with market operators and TSOs/ISOs, using various Asset Dispatch as core platforms (esp. Aspentech DGM solution). Beyond providing 24/7 operational support, you will be responsible for the technical correctness, evolution, and long-term reliability of these Asset Dispatch solutions. You will be a designated expert on how assets are dispatched and controlled in real time, how market instructions and system operator signals are integrated and executed and on how the Asset Dispatch solutions must be configured to reflect operational and regulatory requirements. You are expected to actively extend, adapt, and improve the Asset Dispatch solutions as the asset portfolio, market rules, and regulatory landscape evolve. Finally, to support the continued expansion of the Gas and Power business, and particularly TotalEnergies transition to Power, you will be expected to contribute to a significant change program currently in-progress. You will report to the Team Leader for Asset Control & Management, Gas & Power Trading IT.
• Act as primary technical authority during real-time dispatch incidents
• Troubleshoot all issues impacting generation dispatch, SCADA, AGC behavior, market instructions, TSO communications
• Implement and validate configuration changes when required
• Understand and distinguish market vs real-time operations
• Interface with operators & dispatchers, TSO operational contacts, infrastructure and network support service providers, Asset Dispatch vendor 24/7 support
• Lead incident communication, escalation, and resolution according to SLAs
• Provide 24/7 on-call support (weekly rotation) for the Asset Dispatch solutions in use
• Support and troubleshoot Asset Dispatch functional and technical configurations and perform advanced root cause analysis It is also expected that you can identify and clearly demonstrate when an issue lies outside the Asset Dispatch solution (infrastructure, networking, firewalling, OS, VMs, etc.). Candidate Profile:
• 6+ years of work experience in a power production, utility or trading environment, and preferably with knowledge of the energy markets
• Expert in Asset Dispatch functional and technical configuration
• Expert in Power systems, generation dispatch (market-based, real-time) and AGC logic
• Advanced knowledge in SCADA within a dispatch environment
• Some level of experience in developing interfaces to 3rd party systems (Python, Java)
• Working knowledge of Virtualization, networking fundamentals (routing, firewalls, certificates), Linux and Windows servers
• Solid expertise in incident management under high-pressure / real-time environments
• Clear, structured communication with operators and external stakeholders
• Experience working under SLAs and escalation procedures
• Experience working with external service providers (delivery follow-up, contract management, etc.)
• Educated to at least degree level or an equivalent in a business, computer science or a similar technology or engineering discipline
• Fluent in English; competency in French is advantageous Note: knowledge of the Asset Dispatch solution from Aspentech DGM will be considered a plus. Additional Information: TotalEnergies values diversity, promotes individual growth and offers equal opportunity careers.

jobs.title: Shipping Operator
jobs.description:
Context & Environment: Join TotalEnergies Trading & Shipping in Geneva TotalEnergies Trading & Shipping is a key pillar of the TotalEnergies Group, contributing to the safe, efficient and reliable flow of energy across global markets. Based in Geneva, our Shipping teams play a central role in the execution of maritime operations, working closely with Trading, Chartering, Technical, Vetting and external partners to ensure the smooth and compliant movement of cargoes worldwide. We are looking for a Shipping Operator to join our team. This is a key operational role for someone with strong maritime experience, excellent coordination skills and the ability to manage complex voyages in a fast-moving international environment. Activities: What you will do As a Shipping Operator, you will coordinate daily shipping operations and ensure the safe, efficient and compliant execution of voyages from pre-fixture to post-voyage. Your responsibilities will include:
• Coordinating and monitoring vessel operations across the full voyage lifecycle
• Acting as a key point of contact with shipowners, charterers, agents and internal stakeholders
• Working closely with Trading, Chartering, Technical, Vetting and other support functions
• Ensuring voyage execution in line with contractual terms, operational requirements and internal procedures
• Optimizing voyages for chartered vessels, taking into account safety, efficiency, timing and cost
• Monitoring operational performance, incidents, delays and associated costs
• Supporting risk management and ensuring compliance with HSE standards
• Contributing to the continuous improvement of operational processes and ways of working Candidate Profile: What we are looking for You have a minimum of 3 years’ seagoing experience as an Officer on gas carriers, ideally LPG or LNG vessels. You will thrive in this role if you:
• Have solid experience in maritime operations, shipping or fleet management
• Have a strong understanding of voyage operations and the maritime environment
• Are familiar with shipping contracts, operational processes and voyage execution
• Are rigorous, reactive and able to manage multiple priorities under time pressure
• Have strong organizational skills and excellent attention to detail
• Communicate clearly and effectively with both internal and external stakeholders
• Demonstrate team spirit, reliability and a strong sense of commitment Additional Information: TotalEnergies values diversity, promotes individual growth and offers equal opportunity careers.

jobs.description:
Context & Environment: TotalEnergies has developed a strong expertise in oil and biofuels, natural gas and electricity trading. Trading entities are based in Geneva, Paris, Houston and Singapore. TotalEnergies installed its European trading hub across in Geneva, which now bring together very large teams around trading activities: TotalEnergies Trading & Shipping (T&S ) and TotalEnergies Gas and Power (TGP). TotalEnergies Gas and Power (TGP) is the trading arm of TotalEnergies in the field of low carbon energies. As such, it operates in fast-evolving market dynamics influenced by internal and external factors that require constant adaptation and evolution. The Trading division in Geneva is responsible for optimising the purchase & sales portfolios of gas, electricity, CO2 emissions, dry bulk, and LNG in all recognised markets worldwide, in compliance with the Company trading guidelines. In such context, TGP helps to ensure growth and profitability to a key segment of the business in order to reach the objective of Carbon Neutrality by 2050. Based in Geneva, the ML Modelling & Delivery team within the Algo Strategies for Trading group develops machine learning solutions and software tools that support trading desks in their decision-making. The team works in a fast-moving environment shaped by evolving market dynamics, climate policies and the transformation of the energy sector. This internship offers a unique opportunity to apply machine learning, data science and software development in a real-world trading environment, contributing to practical tools and models used by business teams. Activities: What you will do As an intern, you will contribute to the development of short-term power algorithmic trading strategies based on machine learning models. Depending on the team’s priorities and your profile, your responsibilities may include:
• Developing a solid understanding of European power markets, including their structure and short-term dynamics
• Integrating new data sources, including market, fundamental or alternative data, into existing modelling pipelines
• Performing feature engineering to identify relevant signals from newly integrated data
• Designing, training and evaluating machine learning models using AutoML libraries and other ML frameworks
• Backtesting predictive models and algorithmic trading strategies
• Contributing to portfolio construction and risk management approaches
• Monitoring and analysing model performance in paper trading and production environments
• Supporting the development of robust, reusable software tools for trading and modelling activities Candidate Profile: What we are looking for You are currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering or a related quantitative field. You will thrive in this role if you:
• Have a strong interest in machine learning, data science, software engineering and energy markets
• Have a solid understanding of data science and machine learning principles, combined with familiarity with software development
• Alternatively, bring strong software development skills with a working knowledge of data science and machine learning concepts
• Are proficient in Python
• Have experience with machine learning libraries such as Scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow or similar frameworks
• Are curious, rigorous and eager to learn in a fast-paced trading environment
• Enjoy solving complex problems and turning data into practical, actionable insights
• Are proactive and comfortable working both independently and as part of a team
• Are fluent in English; French is a plus We are committed to meet the energy needs of a growing population and we are committed to the energy transition. The volatility of the energy trading markets requires excellence in risk management and a culture of innovation. We are fully embracing the digital revolution. Our people flourish in an environment that promotes expertise, entrepreneurship spirit, agility and a purpose-driven culture, generating boundless opportunities to learn, grow and achieve collaborative success. Reinforcing the competencies of our people is a key pillar of our culture: we train our people to ensure their development and we pledge to encourage safety in all our actions. We look for passion, ambition and open-mindedness. While we evolve in a demanding industry that requests to be always on the edge, we cultivate a friendly workplace where our people feel good, where team spirit and respect guide our daily routine, where the diversity of our people and their skills create a nourishing experience for all of us. Additional Information: TotalEnergies values diversity, promotes individual growth and offers equal opportunity careers.

jobs.description:

Today, thanks to an international openness, a political and economic stability and strong competences in the financing of commodity trading and shipping, Switzerland has a leading position in international commodity trade. This is why TotalEnergies installed naturally its European trading hub across oil and biofuels, natural gas and electricity in Geneva, which now bring together very large teams around trading activities: Trading & Shipping (T&S) and TotalEnergies Gas and Power (TGP). T&S is a trading company in charge of all physical trading and shipping of crude oil and refined products on behalf of the TotalEnergies Company. It has been an active participant all over the supply chain as well as on the derivatives paper market in order to manage the market risk for a long time). As such, it operates in fast-evolving market dynamics influenced by internal and external factors that require constant adaptation and evolution. Activities: The position is located in Geneva, within the tax department dedicated to support the trading activities. The role focus on gas and power topics and include to work closely with the rest of the team. You will directly report to the indirect tax manager, based in Geneva. Member of a dynamic team, you will collaborate with a wide variety of contacts (other departments within the company, tax advisors and law firms in different regions worldwide, counterparties, customs and tax authorities) on various topics. Trading activity is a fast and an evolving activity in a dynamical and complex environment. For this reason, the Tax department needs to deeply understand the activity and react instantaneously. What you will do:
• Analysis of customs and VAT legislation where trading operates (mainly Europe, Middle East, Africa). Advise accordingly operations, trading and legal departments.
• Review commercials contracts from taxes perspective.
• Answer question received from customs and fiscal authorities in case of an audit.
• Prepare and present internal training to newcomers on customs and tax questions.
• Participate to customs and tax arrangements where the trading perform activities (analysis with local advisors, arrangements, formalities,….)
• Participate to presentations, seminars et trainings organized by customs and tax advisers to anticipate new customs and fiscal questions.
• Elaborate constant IT improvements within our system to ensure the VAT compliance of our activities.
• Assist and answer preliminary direct taxes questions.
• Prepare VAT returns in various countries where the company is registered.
• Review of invoices from VAT perspective. Candidate Profile:
• Relevant Master degree, or equivalent, in law, business or economy
• A proven experience in international tax and VAT, of at least 3 years
• English required/ French an advantage
• Sound interest in IT development is a plus
• Ability to quickly facilitate contact with internal (operations, trading, contracts, legal, accounting treasury….) and external (advisers, competitors, clients, internal Customs/Tax advisors of the Group Total)
• Flexible, working independently as well as in a team environment.
• Ability to prioritize multiple assignments and remain responsive to internal/external inquiries. jobs.title: Business Analyst Finance – Shared Services
jobs.description:
Context & Environment: In a constantly evolving business environment, Information Systems and Digital are the factory of Trading & Shipping. They are at the heart and inseparable from business processes. In a context of rapid changes in the business scope, particularly in the field of renewable energies, strong competition, the business demands on Information Systems and Digital are extremely high. These last are one of the cornerstones of the overall performance of Tradings . Without reliable Information Systems, scalable and efficient and a Digital laboratory providing ever more innovative tools, there is no trading. Context & Environment: Desired start date ASAP (August / September) We are offering an internship for someone who intends to be involved in a challenging trading environment, as well as project related activities. The fast-paced trading environment requires the jobholder to be able to work both autonomously and as part of a team. The position requires strong communication skills within the team, externally and with other departments within the organisation. Both industry and contractual deadlines need to be respected to meet all of the company’s obligations. Reporting and monitoring obligations per the Dodd-Frank Act, EMIR, Sarbanes-Oxley Act and to comply with other rules & regulations require diligence and attention to detail. Activities: As part of the Global Trading Support organisation, the jobholder is part of a team that is an integral part of the trading floor based in Geneva and is also supporting the trading functions in Houston and Singapore. The team works closely with the Traders, Operations, Originators, Middle Office, Energy Data Management, Legal & Compliance, Credit, Treasury, Trading Accounting and the IT teams. Key responsibilities :
• Assist in managing a portfolio of trading counterparts
• Ensure daily that accurate trading information is represented within our ‘in-house’ trading system (the BOOK) by checking recap/nomination/contract/confirmation
• Confirm deals with counterparts and brokers on a daily basis
• Chase and comment all outstanding confirmations on a daily basis
• Ensure that deals are linked to a legal contract
• Process and send sales invoices to counterparts, in line with contractual terms
• Process purchase invoices and submit payment instructions to finance in a timely manner to comply with contractual payment dates
• Reconcile outstanding items with counterparts
• Assist internally to Back Office related queries from internal and external counterparties in a timely fashion
• Help with the overall team responsibilities and goals including assisting with general Back Office duties including: emailing, archiving and filing when needed
• Support and testing on system developments
• Participate in team and individual projects delegated by the Global Back Office Manager
• Regular internal & external audits, and regulatory obligations Candidate Profile: The fast-paced trading environment requires the jobholder to be able to work both autonomously and as part of a team. jobs.description:
Context & Environment: 6-month internship Start date: Ideally October 2026, could be flexible for a start in September as well We are seeking a high-potential, analytically driven engineering-minded Procurement Analyst Intern to join our team. This internship offers deep exposure to real-life commodity trading operations, hands-on experience in procurement, data-driven decision-making, and supplier management within a high-pressure and fast trading environment. The successful candidate will support strategic sourcing initiatives and take ownership of structuring, analysing and improving complex operational problems, directly contributing to cost efficiency, risk control, and supplier performance. As a Procurement Analyst Intern within T&S Trading Operations, you will join a 30-member Operations Technical Services (OTS) team supporting trading activities and actively preserving PnL in day-to-day operations. Your responsibilities will focus on procurement activities for service providers such as inspection companies, superintendents, and additive suppliers. You will help generate concrete, measurable business impact by optimising procurement processes, managing tenders and Request for Proposals (RFP), improving cost transparency and contract coverage, and designing, prototyping and (where relevant) deploying data-driven or automated solutions, while fostering strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders. What makes this internship distinctive This internship is designed for engineers who want to see the real-world impact of their analytical and technical skills in a trading environment. High-performing interns are given increasing ownership, exposure and responsibility throughout the internship, based strictly on results and impact. Activities:
• Collect, analyse, structure and interpret procurement datasets to support fast, fact-based operational decisions.
• Identify service providers without framework agreements or with insufficient contractual, KYC or compliance coverage.
• Support the preparation and execution of RFPs and tenders, including problem structuring with stakeholders, timeline management and data consolidation.
• Analyse supplier proposals (pricing logic, compliance, service levels, performance indicators) to challenge market practices and optimise value creation.
• Monitor supplier performance and adherence to contractual commitments.
• Maintain procurement documentation and ensure data consistency, reliability and traceability across tools.
• Conduct cost analysis, benchmarking and quantitative market intelligence exercises.
• Oversee service provider onboarding to ensure alignment with HSE, contracts, pricing structures and internal standards.
• Work closely with Finance, Operations, Trading Desks, IT and Legal teams in a front-office-adjacent environment.
• Participate in analytical and data-backed price negotiations with service providers.
• Represent TotalEnergies professionally and uphold the company’s image in all interactions.
• Proactively propose ideas to automate, simplify or redesign workflows and improve procurement tools. Ownership, intellectual curiosity and a builder mindset are essential in this role. Objectives
• Gain hands-on experience in high-impact service procurement within a global trading organisation.
• Improve contractual coverage, cost transparency and quantified cost & risk control.
• Enhance the usability, automation level and technical robustness of internal procurement tools.
• Contribute to the development of clear, structured and scalable procurement frameworks.
• Streamline service provider onboarding while maintaining TotalEnergies’ operational and HSE standards.
• Build a strong hybrid analytical/business skillset relevant for trading and trading operations environments. Candidate Profile:
• Final year of a Master’s degree in Engineering or quantitative disciplines (Industrial, Mechanical, Civil, Energy, Data, IT, Applied Maths, Operations Research). Candidates from top engineering schools (EPFL, Centrale, Mines, etc.) are particularly encouraged to apply.
• Strong analytical and problem-structuring mindset; you naturally think in systems, models and data.
• Demonstrated interest in commodities markets, trading or trading operations.
• Prior experience in data analysis, coding, optimisation, operations, logistics or quantitative modelling.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Advanced proficiency in Excel and data visualisation tools (Power BI).
• Proficiency in Python with the ability to prototype, automate and, when relevant, deploy solutions into real operational tools. Exposure to AI / LLM tools applied to business problems is a strong plus.
• Fluent in English and French.
• Fast learner, hands-on, results-oriented, comfortable operating under time pressure.
• Strong communication skills and ability to interact with senior and operational stakeholders.
• Internship must be covered by a tripartite agreement. The internship takes place within the fast-moving environment of international commodity trading, where decisions are time-sensitive and directly linked to financial outcomes. The OTS team supports Trading Operations and Front Office teams by managing critical operational and commercial interfaces with external service providers. The intern will interact with a wide range of stakeholders (trading desks, operations, invoicing, legal, compliance) and external partners across inspection, logistics, customs and shipping services, gaining a rare, end-to-end understanding of how trading operations actually work. Context & Environment: Desired Start Date: September 1st The Intern will be working in the Credit Analysis team of TGP and will report to Portfolio & Credit Analytics Manager. The Trading activity accounts for almost 90% of Gas and Power’s revenue, representing over £10 billion per annum of delivered natural gas, LNG, power, coal and emissions. Transactions average in excess of 10,000 per month covering both intra-desk and external counterparty deals. The counterparts for these operations and contracts take various forms (such as long-term contracts, forwards, futures, options, swaps, transportation and storage). You will join the credit team whose role is to assist in the day-to-day management of the counterpart portfolio risk under the Gas and Power sectors mainly. You will be a member of a team of professionals handling over 1.000 counterparties representing billion of US Dollars in credit lines. Activities: You will assist the team members on its operational activities:
• Goal : Reviewing and establishing credit limits on counterparties in the Gas/LNG and Power portfolio.
• Action : Credit risk analysis and preparation of credit risk summary including recommendation on credit limits , terms, and risk mitigation.
• Support credit team with daily requests from commercial and other teams
• Tools : Familiar with financial and macro analysis techniques. Candidate Profile: You profile
• You are pursuing a Finance Master degree and currently enrolled in your final year.
• Having a p revious experience working in a Finance commodity-trading organisation is a plus.
• You have good communication skills, a can-do attitude and demonstrate a genuine team spirit.
• You know how to work in an evolving environment where pressure and urgency are daily occurrences.
• You have strong English verbal and writing skills, French is a plus.
• A Tripartite agreement is mandatory. Additional Information: TotalEnergies values diversity, promotes individual growth and offers equal opportunity careers.
